x-m-h3-08.title: An ce tabbatacce ne, amma shin mutumin da gaske yana da cutar?
x-m-h3-08.goal: Zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata domin nemo yiwuwar sharaɗi, sannan ka bayyana da lambobi dalilin da ya sa daidaiton gwaji ya bambanta da “yiwuwar kasancewa da cuta idan sakamakon gwaji tabbatacce ne.”
x-m-h3-08.material: Gwajin wata cuta ya nuna sakamako “tabbatacce”. Kana son sanin yiwuwar cewa mutumin da sakamakonsa tabbatacce ne yana da cutar da gaske. Tantance bayanin da ake buƙata domin nemo wannan yiwuwar.
x-m-h3-08.thinking.0: Bambance bayanin da ake buƙata da wanda ba a buƙata ba
x-m-h3-08.thinking.1: Kada ka rikita yiwuwar sharaɗi biyun P(positive|sick) da P(sick|positive).
x-m-h3-08.thinking.2: Bayyana ta amfani da lambobi na zahiri (mutane)
x-m-h3-08.prereq.0: Kware wajen koyon ƙa’idar ninka yiwuwar da ma’anar yiwuwar sharaɗi
x-m-h3-08.prereq.1: Kware wajen mayar da rabo zuwa adadin mutane
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da suke da matuƙar muhimmanci domin nemo yiwuwar cewa mutumin da sakamakon gwajinsa tabbatacce ne da gaske yana da cuta.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ka tuna rukuni biyun da mutanen da sakamakon gwajinsu tabbatacce ya kasu cikinsu.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin rabon da kake buƙata domin sanin girman kowane rukuni.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.r.a: Rabon jinsi ba wani abu ba ne da ke tantance adadin majiyyata ko yiwuwar samun sakamakon gwaji tabbatacce. Ka yi tunanin yadda aka raba yawan mutanen.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.o.b: Rabon duk mutanen da suke da wannan cutar
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.r.b: Ka nuna yadda yawan majiyyata ya shahara a duk yawan jama’a. Idan cutar ba kasafai ake samunta ba, majiyyata na iya zama kaɗan har ma cikin waɗanda sakamakon gwajinsu tabbatacce ne.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.o.c: Yiwuwar majiyyaci ya sami sakamakon gwaji tabbatacce
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.r.c: Ka nuna yadda gwajin yake gano majiyyata.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.r.d: Lokacin jinya ba wani abu ba ne da ke tantance rabon majiyyata cikin waɗanda suka sami sakamako tabbatacce. Ka yi tunanin rabon da ke samar da yiwuwar.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.o.e: Yiwuwar mutumin da ba shi da cutar ya sami sakamakon gwaji tabbatacce
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.r.e: Ka nuna yadda mutane masu ƙoshin lafiya ke samun sakamakon ƙarya. Idan masu ƙoshin lafiya sun fi yawa sosai, wannan mataki yana da muhimmanci.
x-m-h3-08.s.s1.explain: Waɗanda suka sami sakamako tabbatacce sun ƙunshi “majiyyatan da gwajinsu ya nuna tabbatacce” da “masu ƙoshin lafiya da gwajinsu ya nuna tabbatacce”. Saboda haka ana buƙatar rabon majiyyata, yiwuwar majiyyaci ya sami sakamako tabbatacce, da yiwuwar mai ƙoshin lafiya ya sami sakamako tabbatacce.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.prompt: A ɗauka an gwada mutane 1000. Kashi 2% na kowa majiyyata ne, kashi 90% na majiyyata suna samun sakamako tabbatacce, kashi 5% na waɗanda ba majiyyata ba kuma suna samun sakamako tabbatacce. Kimanin wane kaso na waɗanda sakamakonsu tabbatacce ne majiyyata ne?
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Raba mutane 1000 zuwa majiyyata da masu ƙoshin lafiya, ka rubuta adadin kowane rukuni.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo adadin waɗanda suka sami sakamako tabbatacce a kowane rukuni, tara su, sannan ka kwatanta nawa daga cikinsu majiyyata ne.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.r.a: Ka ɗauki yiwuwar majiyyaci ya sami sakamako tabbatacce, wato 90%, a matsayin “yiwuwar kasancewa majiyyaci idan sakamako tabbatacce ne”. An juya sharaɗin.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.r.b: Ka ƙirga ka kwatanta yawan majiyyata da masu ƙoshin lafiya cikin waɗanda suka sami sakamako tabbatacce.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.r.c: Ka yi tunanin cewa bayanin sakamakon gwaji tabbatacce ba ya sauya rabon. Idan sakamakon mutum tabbatacce ne, rabon yana ƙaruwa fiye da rabon asali.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.r.d: Ka kiyasta cewa idan sakamako tabbatacce ne, majiyyata da masu ƙoshin lafiya rabonsu ya yi daidai. Ka manta cewa girman rukunonin biyu ya bambanta sosai.
x-m-h3-08.s.s2.explain: Cikin mutane 1000, majiyyata 20 ne, masu ƙoshin lafiya kuma 980. Waɗanda suka sami sakamako tabbatacce sun haɗa da majiyyata 18 (90% na 20) da masu ƙoshin lafiya 49 (5% na 980). Saboda haka cikin kusan 67 da sakamakonsu tabbatacce ne, kusan 18 majiyyata ne, wato kusan 27%.
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.prompt: Ko da gwajin yana ba da sakamako tabbatacce ga 90% na majiyyata, bayyana da lambobi na zahiri kamar mutane 1000 dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar cewa mutumin da aka gwada tabbatacce yana da cutar ta fi 90% ƙasa sosai.
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta adadin mutane idan ka raba mutane 1000 zuwa rukuni biyu.
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta yawan mutanen da suka sami sakamako tabbatacce a kowane rukuni, sannan ka kwatanta.
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A cikin bayanina, za a iya ganin ƙungiyoyi biyun da mutanen da sakamakonsu ya zama tabbatacce suka ƙunsa?
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta adadin “majiyyatan da gwajinsu ya nuna tabbatacce” da “masu ƙoshin lafiya da gwajinsu ya nuna tabbatacce” da lambobi?
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.model.0: Cikin mutane 1000, 20 majiyyata ne, kuma 18 daga cikinsu sun sami sakamako tabbatacce. x-m-h3-08.s.s3.model.1: Majiyyata kashi 2% ne kawai, saboda haka masu ƙoshin lafiya sun fi su yawa ƙwarai. Idan mutane 1000 ne, akwai majiyyata 20 da masu ƙoshin lafiya 980. Ko da kashi 5% kawai na masu ƙoshin lafiya suka sami sakamako tabbatacce, wannan kusan mutane 49 ne, fiye da majiyyata 18 da gwajinsu ya nuna tabbatacce.
x-m-h3-08.s.s3.model.2: Cikin mutane 1000, majiyyata 20 ne, kuma 18 daga cikinsu sun sami sakamako tabbatacce. Mutane 49 marasa cutar ma sun sami sakamako tabbatacce, don haka cikin masu sakamako tabbatacce 67, majiyyata 18 ne kawai, wato kusan 27%.

x-m-h3-07.title: Menene tazarar amincewa 95% ke gaya mana?
x-m-h3-07.goal: Zaɓi bayanin da ke fassara tazarar amincewa daidai, sannan ka gano da kanka girman samfurin da ake buƙata domin tsawon tazarar ya cika sharadi.
x-m-h3-07.material: An ce lokacin barcin yau da kullum na ɗaliban sakandare a wani birni yana bin rarrabawar normal mai karkacewar ma’aunin al’umma sa’a 1. Lokacin da aka zaɓi ɗalibai 100 bisa bazata, matsakaicin samfurin ya zama sa’o’i 6.8. Tazarar amincewa 95% ta matsakaicin al’umma ita ce 6.8 ± 1.96 × (1/√100), wato [6.604, 6.996]. (Domin matakin amincewa 95%, yi amfani da ma’aunin 1.96.)
x-m-h3-07.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko fassara daidai ce ko ba daidai ba tare da dalilai.
x-m-h3-07.thinking.1: Yi tunani game da dangantakar girman samfurin da tsawon tazarar.
x-m-h3-07.thinking.2: Ka duba ƙimomin iyaka da kanka, sannan ka ƙirƙiri ƙimomin da suka cika sharadin.
x-m-h3-07.prereq.0: Kware wajen fahimtar al’umma, samfura, da rarrabawar matsakaicin samfurin.
x-m-h3-07.prereq.1: Kware wajen ganin siffar tazarar amincewa ta amfani da daidaita rarrabawar normal.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi bayanin da ya dace game da ma’anar wannan tazarar amincewa.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko nuna abin da tazarar ke magana a kai (ƙimomin mutum ɗaya ko matsakaicin al’umma).
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da ake maimaitawa idan aka ce “yiwuwa 95%”.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.o.a: Kashi 95% na ɗaliban wannan birni suna yin barci tsakanin sa’o’i 6.604 da 6.996.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.r.a: Tazarar tana game da matsakaicin yawan jama’a ne, ba ɗalibi ɗaya-ɗaya ba. Lokutan barcin ɗalibai dabam-dabam sun bazu sosai fiye da wannan tazara.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.o.b: Yiwuwar matsakaicin sabon samfurin da aka zana ya faɗa cikin wannan tazara ita ce 95%.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.r.b: An tsara wannan tazara domin ta ƙunshi matsakaicin yawan jama’a, ba domin ta nuna zangon sabon matsakaicin samfurin ba. Yiwuwar sabon matsakaicin samfurin ya faɗa cikin wannan tazara ta fi ƙasa.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.o.c: Idan aka zana samfurori akai-akai aka gina tazara, kusan 95% na tazarorin za su ƙunshi matsakaicin yawan jama’a.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka nuna ma’anar cewa wannan shi ne adadin nasara idan aka maimaita amfani da hanya mai matakin amincewa iri ɗaya sau da yawa.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.o.d: Daga cikin ɗalibai 100 na samfurin, 95 suna barci na tsawon lokacin da ke cikin wannan tazara.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.r.d: Tazara ce ta matsakaicin yawan jama’a, ba ta ƙimomin ɗaliban samfurin ɗaya-ɗaya ba.
x-m-h3-07.s.s1.explain: Matakin amincewa 95% yana nufin amincewa da hanyar: “idan aka zana samfurori akai-akai ta hanya iri ɗaya aka gina tazarori, kusan 95% daga cikinsu za su ƙunshi matsakaicin yawan jama’a.” Ba magana ba ce game da ɗalibi ɗaya ko sabon matsakaicin samfurin.

x-m-h3-04.s.s1.line.0: A ɗauka cewa jimillar da aka tara zuwa har abada S = 1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + … tana da wata lambar real.

x-m-h3-04.s.s1.explain: Tushen kuskuren yana layi na 1, inda aka ɗauka cewa S lambar real ce. Jimillolin ɓangare-ɓangare na jerin su ne 1, 3, 7, 15, … kuma suna ƙaruwa ba iyaka; saboda haka babu lambar da jimillar za ta tsaya a kanta. Idan ka ɗauka cewa akwai lambar da babu ita sannan ka sauya furuci, za ka iya samun sakamako marar ma’ana kamar na layi na 4.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i 2 na (a, r), masu r mabambanta, ta yadda jimillar jerin geometric marar iyaka mai kalmar farko a da rabon gama-gari r ta zama 5. (Ana iya amfani da ƙimomin goma, r ≠ 0.)

x-m-h3-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan r=0 ko cikakken ƙimarsa bai gaza 1 ba, ba za a tantance jimillar a matsayin lamba ba.
x-m-h3-04.s.s2.explain: Domin jimillar ta wanzu, ana buƙatar |r| < 1; idan jimillar 5 ce, to a = 5(1 − r). Misali, idan r = 0.4, to a = 3; idan r = −0.2, to a = 6. a = −5, r = 2 yana cika dabara a = 5(1 − r) kawai, amma jimillar ba ta wanzu.

x-m-h3-01.title: Ƙimar tabbataccen integral ita ce 0, amma shin faɗin yankin ma 0 ne?
x-m-h3-01.goal: Ka fahimci cewa ƙimar tabbataccen integral da faɗin siffa na iya bambanta; nemo layin da kuskure ya fara a cikin mafita, sannan ka zaɓi hanyar gyara kuskuren.
x-m-h3-01.material: Wani ɗalibi ya nemo faɗin yankin da ke tsakanin lanƙwasa y=x²−4x+3, axis ɗin x, da layukan x=0 da x=3 kamar haka. (A bayani maimakon hoto: lanƙwasar tana haɗuwa da axis ɗin x a x=1 da x=3; idan x yana tsakanin 0 da 1, tana sama da axis ɗin x, idan kuma x yana tsakanin 1 da 3, tana ƙasa da axis ɗin x.)

x-m-h3-01.thinking.1: Bayyana sanadin kuskuren ta amfani da ma’anar alamar tabbataccen integral
x-m-h3-01.thinking.2: Kwatanta da kimanta hanyoyin gyara kuskuren
x-m-h3-01.prereq.0: Kware wajen ƙididdige tabbatattun integral na ayyukan polinomial
x-m-h3-01.prereq.1: Kware wajen koyon alaƙar tabbataccen integral da faɗin yankin ƙarƙashin lanƙwasa
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda inda matsala ta farko ta bayyana a mafitar ɗalibin. (Wasu layukan suna ɗauke da ƙididdiga daidai.)
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta kowane layi ka bincika: “shin ya biyo kai tsaye daga layin da ya gabata?”
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ko da ƙididdigar daidai ce, ka bincika ko wannan ƙididdigar tana nemo abin da ka yi niyya. Ka tuna, tazara bayan tazara, wane ɓangare tsakanin lanƙwasa da axis ɗin x ne ƙimar layi na 4 ta ƙirga, kuma da wace alama.
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.0: Bari f(x)=x²−4x+3, kuma bari S ya zama faɗin yankin tsakanin lanƙwasar da axis ɗin x a tazarar [0, 3].
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.1: Saita S=∫₀³ f(x) dx. (tabbataccen integral na f(x) daga 0 zuwa 3)
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.2: F(x)=x³/3−2x²+3x madadin integral ne na f(x).
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka S=0. Ko da yake a fili akwai yanki tsakanin lanƙwasar da axis ɗin x, faɗin ya zama 0.
x-m-h3-01.s.s1.explain: Ƙididdigar (layi na 3 da na 4) daidai ce. Matsalar tana cikin tsarin layi na 2. Tabbataccen integral ƙima ce da take ƙirga ɓangaren sama da axis ɗin x da alamar +, na ƙasa kuma da alamar −, saboda haka 4/3 na [0,1] da −4/3 na [1,3] sun soke juna suka zama 0. Faɗin yanki ba ya la’akari da alamar, don haka ƙarshen layi na 5 ma kuskure ne da tsarin ya haifar.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi hanyar da ta dace domin nemo faɗin yankin daidai.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin dalilin da ya sa tabbataccen integral ya zama 0 ta raba ɓangaren sama da na ƙasa.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowace hanya tana ƙirga ɓangaren sama da axis ɗin x da na ƙasa a matsayin faɗi mai kyau.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.a: Nemo tabbataccen integral a duk tazarar [0, 3], sannan ka ɗauki cikakkiyar ƙimar sakamakon a matsayin faɗin yankin.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.a: Jimillar ta zama 0 ne saboda ɓangaren sama da na ƙasa sun soke juna. Ko da ka ɗauki cikakkiyar ƙima bayan soke juna, ba za a dawo da faɗin ɓangarorin biyu ba.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.b: Cire tazarar da lanƙwasar take ƙasa da axis ɗin x, ka yi integral ne kawai a tazarar da take sama.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.b: Yankin da ke ƙasa da axis ɗin x ma yana cikin yankin da lanƙwasar da axis ɗin x suka kewaye. Alamar sa kawai ita ce −, amma faɗin wannan ɓangaren tabbatacce ne.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.c: Raba tazarar a x=1, inda alamar ke sauyawa; ɗauki cikakkiyar ƙimar tabbataccen integral na kowace tazara, sannan ka tara su.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.c: Wannan hanya tana raba a inda alamar ke sauyawa, sannan ta ƙirga ɓangaren sama da na ƙasa dabam-dabam.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.o.d: Nemo matsakaicin f(0) da f(3) a ƙarshen biyun, sannan ka ninka da tsawon tazara 3 domin samun faɗin.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.r.d: Lanƙwasar ba madaidaiciyar layi ba ce, saboda haka matsakaicin ƙimomin ƙarshen ba zai iya wakiltar lanƙwasar gaba ɗaya ba.
x-m-h3-01.s.s2.explain: Raba a x=1 yana ba da ∫₀¹ f=4/3 da ∫₁³ f=−4/3; faɗin yankin kuwa 4/3+|−4/3|=8/3.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta saƙo ga abokin da ya yi amfani da wannan mafita, ka bayyana masa yadda “ƙimar tabbataccen integral” da “faɗin yanki” suka bambanta a wannan matsala, da kuma faɗin daidai.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bayyana ɓangaren sama da na ƙasa kowannensu da kalmomi.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.hint.1: A ƙarshe, rubuta faɗin yankin daidai a matsayin lamba.
x-m-h3-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A cikin bayaninka, shin dalilin da ya sa tabbataccen integral ya zama 0 yana da alaƙa da ɓangarorin sama da ƙasa?

x-m-h3-01.s.s3.model.0: Tabbataccen integral yana ƙirga ɓangaren da ke ƙasa da axis ɗin x da alamar mara kyau, saboda haka 4/3 na sama da −4/3 na ƙasa sun soke juna suka zama 0. Ana samun faɗin yankin ta hanyar raba tazarar a x=1 da tara cikakkun ƙimomin, wato 8/3.

Bari vector ɗin alkiblar layukan l da m su zama u=(u1, u2, u3) da v=(v1, v2, v3), sannan ka ɗauka layukan biyun suna tsaye da n.

x-m-h3-10.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin misalin da ya karyata iƙirarin.

x-m-h3-10.prereq.1: Kware wajen bayyana kusurwar tsakanin vector biyu da tsayuwarsu ta amfani da vector
